_note: Single source of truth for developer toolchain versions. scripts/dev-env.mjs reads this file; package.json (engines / packageManager) and .github/workflows/ci.yml are kept aligned with it. .python-version is intentionally NOT used because .gitignore:25 ignores that file.

tauriSystemDeps.linux: sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config libasound2-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libssl-dev libxdo-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev

pythonInstallHints.win32: Install Python 3.12 from python.org, or: winget install --id Python.Python.3.12 -e
pythonInstallHints.linux: sudo apt-get install -y python3.12 python3.12-venv (Ubuntu 22.04 may need the deadsnakes PPA)

_network: Optional CN mirror/proxy policy is opt-in: set SOUNDFLOW_CN_NETWORK=1 or pass --cn to scripts/dev-env.mjs; the default never overrides a developer's proxy environment.
